what: 2-4 number tiles from the articles, each with its label, its number counted up and its own unit: items [{label, value, unit}]
use_when: 2-4 numbers the articles state, side by side, that are not one kind (different units, or not a ranking)
avoid_when: one number (stat); values of one unit to compare from zero (bars); values over time (trend); a before and after (change)
